snippet.title: Night Plane - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Welcome aboard Night Plane, a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant aboard a plane that may be carrying more than ordinary passengers. Set in 1999, Night Plane blends psychological horror with flight attendant simulation gameplay, wrapped in a retro-inspired visual style, dark humor, and corporate cynicism. Your job doesn't stop when things start getting strange. Follow protocol, keep your passengers happy, and pay attention to every detail — because not everyone aboard is who they claim to be. The Night Plane Demo is available now for FREE on Steam.

🎮 Play the Demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/50...

🤝 Wishlist Night Plane:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/33...

💬 Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/RsSfDRpJZg

👀 Follow us on X:
https://x.com/NightPlaneGame
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
